expected_changes.where: FE application (repo unavailable: FE.txt PWD resolves to /Users/galangkeda/Documents/Keda/L-DX_Backend, branch feat/ringi-156 does not exist there)

test_cases.title: Should be able to display only invoices matching the selected Invoice Type after Search (per-type result sets)
preconditions: Invoice List (INV-060-013) accessible with a valid session
Billing To masters with distinct Invoice Types exist: BTM-A=super_simple, BTM-B=detailed, BTM-C=direct_debit
At least one invoice issued per master
steps: POST /api/dataset/sales.billing.invoice/search_read with domain [('sales_billing_to_invoice_type','=','super_simple')]
Repeat the same call for 'detailed' and for 'direct_debit'
For each response, check every returned record's sales_billing_to_invoice_type value
test_cases.expected_result: Each search returns HTTP 200 and only invoices whose Invoice Type equals the selected value; no invoice of another type appears in any result set

test_cases.title: Should not be able to see non-matching invoices or an error on a zero-match Invoice Type filter (empty list, clean exclusion)
preconditions: Dataset contains invoices of types super_simple, detailed, direct_debit
No invoice of type credit_card exists
steps: POST search_read with domain [('sales_billing_to_invoice_type','=','credit_card')]
POST search_read with domain [('sales_billing_to_invoice_type','=','super_simple')] on the mixed dataset
Inspect returned records for non-matching types
test_cases.expected_result: The zero-match domain returns HTTP 200 with an empty record list (no error, no crash); the filtered mixed dataset contains no row of a type other than the filtered value

test_cases.title: Should be able to get the identical filtered result set after refresh and repeated Search clicks (no duplication or error)
preconditions: Invoice List screen open with invoices of multiple Invoice Types
steps: Select Invoice Type super_simple in the filter and click Search
Browser-refresh the page, then run the same search again
Click Search 5 times in rapid succession on the filtered state
Compare the row sets of every execution
test_cases.expected_result: The screen re-renders without error after refresh; every repeated search returns the identical row set for the same filter; no duplicated rows and no error messages

test_cases.title: Should not be able to view filtered invoice data after session loss mid-search (auth redirect, no data leak)
preconditions: User is on the Invoice List with an Invoice Type value already selected but Search not yet clicked
steps: Expire the session (clear the session cookie / invalidate the token)
Click Search
Re-login and repeat the same filtered search
test_cases.expected_result: The search attempt results in an authentication error or login redirect and returns no invoice data; after re-login the same filter search works and returns the correct matching rows

test_cases.title: Should be able to download exactly the on-screen matching rows from a filter-active list (screen and file agree)
preconditions: Invoices exist for at least two different Invoice Types
The list is currently filtered by one Invoice Type value
steps: POST search_read with domain [('sales_billing_to_invoice_type','=','super_simple')] and record the screen rows
POST /api/dataset/sales.billing.invoice/download_excel with the same domain
Parse the workbook and compare row set and Invoice Type cells against the screen rows
test_cases.expected_result: The downloaded file contains exactly the invoices currently displayed (only matching rows), and each row's Invoice Type cell equals the value shown on screen for that Invoice Number

test_cases.title: Should be able to download Invoice List data that includes the Invoice Type item in every row
preconditions: At least two invoices with different Invoice Types exist
steps: POST download_excel for sales.billing.invoice with the standard Invoice List headers including Invoice Type
Parse the workbook header row and every data row
test_cases.expected_result: HTTP 200; the workbook contains an 'Invoice Type' column and every exported row carries its Invoice Type value in that column

test_cases.title: Should not be able to find the Invoice Type item added to any artifact other than the Invoice List screen and its download file (List and Download only)
preconditions: An invoice with a Billing To master Invoice Type exists
Pre-change baseline of the billing invoice PDF report is available
steps: Render the existing billing invoice PDF report for the seeded invoice
Compare the PDF output and its layout keys against the pre-change baseline
Check the other invoice-related report artifacts exposed by this screen family for any new Invoice Type item
test_cases.expected_result: No report or print artifact other than the Invoice List screen and its download file contains the new Invoice Type item; the invoice PDF output is unchanged versus the pre-change baseline (AMB-004 answer: 'List and Download only')

test_cases.title: Should be able to receive complete well-formed files when Download is triggered twice in rapid succession (double-submit)
preconditions: A filter-neutral invoice dataset exists
steps: Fire two download_excel requests back-to-back without waiting for the first to finish
Parse both returned workbooks completely
test_cases.expected_result: Both responses are HTTP 200; each parsed workbook is complete and well-formed (no truncated or corrupted output) and both contain the same rows including the Invoice Type column

test_cases.title: Should not be able to download invoice data with an expired session (clean rejection, retry succeeds)
preconditions: A valid session exists and a download was just configured
steps: Expire the session before starting the download
POST download_excel with the expired session
Re-login and retry the identical download
test_cases.expected_result: The expired-session download is rejected with an authentication error and no file is produced; after re-login the same download succeeds and contains the Invoice Type column

test_cases.title: Should be able to download with the Invoice Type column placed immediately to the right of the Billing To column (exact adjacency)
preconditions: At least one invoice exists so the download produces a header row
steps: POST download_excel with the standard Invoice List headers
Parse the header row and compute index('Invoice Type') and index('Billing To')
test_cases.expected_result: The header row of the downloaded file places 'Invoice Type' exactly one position after 'Billing To' (index difference of exactly 1)

test_cases.title: Should be able to keep every other column in its previous relative order (single insertion, no collateral shift)
preconditions: Pre-change baseline column list of the Invoice List download is recorded
steps: Download the file and extract the full ordered header list
Remove the inserted 'Invoice Type' column from the list
Compare the remaining sequence with the pre-change baseline order
test_cases.expected_result: After removing exactly one 'Invoice Type' occurrence, the remaining columns match the pre-change baseline order; only one new column exists and it sits between 'Billing To' and the column that previously followed it

test_cases.title: Should be able to see a stable Invoice Type column position when the download is triggered repeatedly
preconditions: Invoice dataset unchanged between requests
steps: Trigger download_excel three times in sequence
Parse each header row and record the position of 'Invoice Type' relative to 'Billing To'
test_cases.expected_result: Every response places 'Invoice Type' immediately right of 'Billing To'; the layout is deterministic across repeated triggers

test_cases.title: Should be able to select Invoice Type filter options that are the Invoice Type values set in the Billing To master
preconditions: Billing To masters exist carrying Invoice Type values (e.g. super_simple, detailed, direct_debit)
steps: Read the option list the Invoice List filter exposes (selection of the invoice list Invoice Type field / values from the Billing To master)
Compare the offered options with the Invoice Type values set on the masters
Search once per offered option
test_cases.expected_result: The filter offers exactly the Invoice Type values set on the Billing To master; every offered value is accepted by search (matched rows or a clean empty set)

test_cases.title: Should be able to select every Invoice Type value the master defines (first, last, and all values of the master field)
preconditions: Billing To masters exist covering every Invoice Type value the master field defines
steps: Read the exposed filter options
For each of the seven master values, select it and run a search
test_cases.expected_result: All Invoice Type values defined on the Billing To master field are selectable (first, last, and everything between), and each search completes successfully with only matching rows or a clean empty set

test_cases.title: Should not be able to select or inject Invoice Type options that are not values of the Billing To master (foreign and deprecated values never offered, never match)
preconditions: Masters carry only genuine Billing To Invoice Type values
Invoices exist whose deprecated invoice_type (payment/advance_payment) differs from their Billing To Invoice Type
steps: Inspect every exposed filter option for foreign values
Force a search with each foreign value as domain
Verify no invoice is returned by a foreign value
test_cases.expected_result: None of the foreign values (including the deprecated payment/advance_payment invoice type values) appear as filter options, and a search forced with any of them returns no invoice rows — filtering never matches on a field other than the Billing To master Invoice Type

test_cases.title: Should be able to see filter options track 0, 1, and many distinct Invoice Type values set on Billing To masters
preconditions: Database states can be prepared: no masters with a type; one master with one type; many masters covering all types
steps: State A: no Billing To master carries an Invoice Type — read the filter options
State B: exactly one master with one type — read the options
State C: many masters with all distinct types — read the options
test_cases.expected_result: With no typed masters the filter exposes no Invoice Type value to select; with one typed master exactly that value; with many masters the union of their distinct values — options never include a value not set in the Billing To master and never duplicate a value

test_cases.title: Should be able to see options and rows follow the same master after its Invoice Type is edited (relation by id)
preconditions: Master BTM-A with invoice_print_type super_simple and an issued invoice INV-A
steps: Write BTM-A.invoice_print_type = 'direct_debit' and flush
Read INV-A's Invoice Type and re-read the option membership
Search by the old value super_simple, then by the new value direct_debit
test_cases.expected_result: After the edit, the invoice row and the filterable value follow the current master value (relation by id per AMB-003); the old value no longer returns the invoice and the new value does; options and rows never disagree

test_cases.title: Should be able to output the same Invoice Type value as the screen in each downloaded row (parity across surfaces, en and ja locales)
preconditions: Invoices with at least two different Invoice Types exist
en_US and ja_JP locales are active
steps: In en_US: read the list values per Invoice Number, then download and compare each Invoice Type cell
In ja_JP: repeat both reads and compare again
Flag any Invoice Number where screen and file disagree
test_cases.expected_result: For every Invoice Number, the downloaded Invoice Type cell equals the value displayed on the screen in the same locale; parity holds in both en_US and ja_JP with no row mismatch

test_cases.title: Should not be able to see a substituted value for invoices without an Invoice Type (blank on screen and blank in the file)
preconditions: A masterless invoice exists
An invoice whose master's Invoice Type was cleared exists
steps: Read both invoices' Invoice Type on the list
Download the same dataset and read both rows' Invoice Type cells
test_cases.expected_result: Both surfaces show blank for invoices without an Invoice Type — no placeholder, no default label, no error (AMB-002 answer: 'blank'); screen and file stay consistent

test_cases.title: Should be able to see the downloaded value follow the current master when the type is edited between viewing the screen and downloading
preconditions: Master BTM-A (super_simple) with invoice INV-A
Screen list rendered at time T1
steps: Render the list showing INV-A's Invoice Type (T1)
Edit BTM-A.invoice_print_type to 'direct_debit' (T2) without refreshing the screen
Download the dataset (T3) and read INV-A's Invoice Type cell
Refresh the screen and re-read INV-A's value
test_cases.expected_result: The downloaded cell reflects the master's current Invoice Type at download time (direct_debit per AMB-003); the stale screen shows the old value until refreshed; no mixed or partial value appears anywhere

test_cases.title: Should be able to see an Invoice Type column in the Invoice List search result detail table (INV-060-013)
preconditions: Invoice List screen opened with a search executed
steps: Open the Invoice List and run any search returning rows

Confirm the column shows a value on populated rows
test_cases.expected_result: The search result detail table renders a column labeled 'Invoice Type' and populated rows display a value in it

test_cases.title: Should be able to see the Invoice Type column persist with unchanged values after refreshing the result view
preconditions: Search results with Invoice Type values are on screen
steps: Record the visible Invoice Type values per row
Browser-refresh the result view
Re-run the same search and compare values
test_cases.expected_result: After refresh the detail table re-renders with the Invoice Type column present and the same values per Invoice Number; no error and no missing column

test_cases.title: Should not be able to see invoice data after session loss mid-view (redirect, empty result area)
preconditions: Search results including Invoice Type values are displayed
steps: Expire the session while the results are on screen
Attempt any interaction with the result table (sort, page, re-search)
Re-login and verify the results reappear
test_cases.expected_result: Interaction attempts redirect to login or return an authentication error; no invoice rows or Invoice Type values remain accessible; after re-login the same search restores the view

test_cases.title: Should be able to see each row display the Invoice Type linked to that row's Invoice Number (via its Billing To master)
preconditions: Invoices exist under masters with different Invoice Types
steps: Read every invoice's Invoice Type value (sales_billing_to_invoice_type)
Read each invoice's Billing To master's Invoice Type
Compare per Invoice Number

test_cases.title: Should be able to see blank (not an error or default label) for an invoice with no resolvable Invoice Type
preconditions: A masterless invoice exists
An invoice whose master's Invoice Type is cleared (False) exists
steps: Read the Invoice Type value of the masterless invoice
Read the Invoice Type value of the invoice with the cleared-type master
Render both rows on the list
test_cases.expected_result: Both rows display blank — no error is raised, no default label is substituted (AMB-002 answer: 'blank')

test_cases.title: Should be able to resolve row values for 0, 1, and many invoices (empty list, single row, many rows across types)
preconditions: Three dataset states preparable: zero invoices, one invoice, many invoices under different masters
steps: State 0: search invoices — expect empty list without error
State 1: one invoice — read its Invoice Type
State N: many invoices across masters — read every row's Invoice Type and compare with its own master
test_cases.expected_result: 0 invoices yields an empty list without error; 1 invoice yields its master's type; many invoices yield each row showing its own master's type with no cross-row bleed

test_cases.title: Should be able to see existing invoices follow the CURRENT Billing To master value after edit or reassignment (relation by id)
preconditions: Master BTM-P (super_simple) with invoice INV-P
Master BTM-Q (detailed)
steps: Variant 1: edit BTM-P to 'direct_debit', flush, read INV-P
Variant 2: reassign the billing to BTM-Q, flush, read INV-P; then edit old master BTM-P to 'credit_card' and read INV-P again
Variant 3: clear BTM-Q's Invoice Type (False), flush, read INV-P
test_cases.expected_result: Each mutation recomputes INV-P's Invoice Type from the current master relation (AMB-003 answer: 'Ikut terupdate karena relasinya dari id'): after edit it shows direct_debit; after reassignment it shows detailed and later edits of the old master do not leak; after clearing it shows blank per AMB-002

test_cases.title: Should be able to use an Invoice Type filter item in the Invoice List search condition area (screen INV-060-013)
preconditions: Invoice List screen (INV-060-013) opened by an authorized user
steps: Inspect the search condition area for the Invoice Type filter item
Open the filter and select any offered value
Execute a search with the value selected
test_cases.expected_result: The search condition area shows an 'Invoice Type' filter item; its options are selectable and a search using the item executes normally

test_cases.title: Should be able to recover the filter flow after a mid-configuration refresh or rapid repeated Search clicks
preconditions: Invoice List open, filter not yet used
steps: Open the Invoice Type filter, then browser-refresh before searching
Verify the filter item is present after refresh
Select a value and click Search 5 times rapidly
test_cases.expected_result: After refresh the Invoice Type filter item is present and a fresh search runs cleanly; 5 rapid Search submissions produce one consistent result set without duplicated rows or errors

test_cases.title: Should not be able to continue configuring the filter after session loss (auth redirect, no search executed)
preconditions: User is mid-configuration: the Invoice Type dropdown is open or a value is chosen, Search not clicked
steps: Expire the session
Attempt to select a value / click Search
Re-login and open the filter again
test_cases.expected_result: The attempt redirects to login or returns an authentication error and no search executes; after re-login the Invoice Type filter item is available again and works

test_cases.title: Should be able to keep Invoice List display, search, and download at the current performance level (no significant delay vs pre-change baseline)
preconditions: A volume invoice dataset is seeded (e.g. 10,000+ rows spanning multiple Invoice Types)
Pre-change baseline timings for list display, search, and download are captured in the same environment
steps: Time an unfiltered list search_read on the volume dataset
Time a filtered search (by Invoice Type) on the same dataset
Time a full download of the same dataset and compare all three against the baseline
test_cases.expected_result: All three operations complete successfully (HTTP 200, valid file) with durations showing no significant degradation versus the pre-change baseline; PM confirmed no numeric threshold applies (AMB-001 answer: 'No Need'), so the baseline comparison is the oracle

test_cases.title: Should be able to display, search (with Invoice Type filter), and download as a guest user exactly as before the modification
preconditions: A guest account provisioned with the pre-change Invoice List permission set exists
Pre-change outcome baseline (allowed/denied per operation) is recorded
steps: Log in as the guest account
Display the Invoice List, search with an Invoice Type filter, and download the result
Compare the three outcomes and the data with the pre-change baseline
test_cases.expected_result: Guest outcomes are identical to the pre-change baseline: operations allowed before still succeed and return the same data (including correct Invoice Type values); nothing the guest could not do before becomes possible or breaks

test_cases.title: Should not be able to access Invoice List display, search, or download without Invoice List permission (unchanged rejection, no new access path)
preconditions: A user (guest or internal) without Invoice List access exists
steps: Attempt list search_read, Invoice Type-filtered search_read, and download_excel as this user
Compare rejections with the pre-change baseline
test_cases.expected_result: All three operations are rejected exactly as before the modification; the new Invoice Type field and filter open no additional access path to invoice data

test_cases.title: Should be able to serve two guest accounts on the Invoice List simultaneously with the same correct Invoice Type data
preconditions: Two guest accounts with Invoice List access exist
Both target the same invoice dataset
steps: Open two sessions (guest A and guest B)
Concurrently run the same Invoice Type-filtered search from both
Have guest A download while guest B searches
Compare results and data between sessions
test_cases.expected_result: Both sessions receive identical, correct results for the same filter with no cross-session data mixing, no blocking, and no errors

test_cases.title: Should be able to handle rapid repeated guest searches and downloads without errors, escalation, or inconsistent data
preconditions: Guest session with Invoice List access
steps: Fire 10 rapid search requests (mixed unfiltered and Invoice Type-filtered) as the guest
Fire 3 rapid download requests
Inspect every response
test_cases.expected_result: All requests complete with consistent, correct results; no permission escalation, no server errors, no duplicated or corrupted exports

test_cases.title: Should not be able to observe any archive behavior change after the Invoice Type addition (archive regression)
preconditions: An invoice carrying a populated Invoice Type exists
The pre-change archive baseline for the same flow is recorded
steps: Execute the Invoice List archive action on the invoice
Re-search the list for the archived invoice
Download the same dataset and check for the archived invoice
Compare all outcomes with the pre-change baseline
test_cases.expected_result: Archive completes with the same outcome as the pre-change baseline; the archived invoice no longer appears in list or download exactly as before; the Invoice Type field neither blocks nor alters archiving and no error mentions it

test_cases.title: Should not be able to observe any closing process change on data carrying Invoice Type (closing regression)
preconditions: Billings with invoices carrying Invoice Type exist in an open period
The pre-change closing baseline for the same data shape is recorded
steps: Run the closing process on the period containing these invoices
After closing, read the Invoice List and download the dataset
Compare closing outcome and post-closing display with the baseline
test_cases.expected_result: The closing process completes with the same outcome as the pre-change baseline; afterwards the list and download still resolve each Invoice Type correctly and no closing error references the new field

test_cases.title: Should not be able to observe any time zone display change (datetime columns unchanged, Invoice Type TZ-invariant)
preconditions: User timezone settable (Asia/Tokyo and UTC)
Pre-change baseline rendering of datetime columns is recorded
steps: Set user TZ to Asia/Tokyo: read the list and download; record datetime columns and Invoice Type cells
Switch TZ to UTC and repeat both reads
Compare datetime rendering with the baseline and Invoice Type values across TZs
test_cases.expected_result: Datetime columns render in the user's time zone exactly as before the modification in both list and download; the Invoice Type value is identical across time zones (TZ-invariant label)

answer_keys.why: Requires multi-master/multi-invoice DB seeding and per-type filtered assertions (data-level verification)
prep: Create billing.to.master rows: BTM-R151-A (invoice_print_type=super_simple), BTM-R151-B (detailed), BTM-R151-C (direct_debit)
Create one sales.billing per master (billing_category=invoice) and call _action_create_sales_bill_invoice() so each yields a sales.billing.invoice (INV-SS, INV-DT, INV-DD)
execution: As admin, POST /api/dataset/sales.billing.invoice/search_read with domain [('sales_billing_to_invoice_type','=', '<value>')] once per value
assertions: Each call returns HTTP 200
Domain super_simple returns exactly {INV-SS.id}; detailed returns {INV-DT.id}; direct_debit returns {INV-DD.id}
Every returned record's sales_billing_to_invoice_type equals the filtered value

answer_keys.why: Two-surface comparison (filtered search_read + parsed workbook) with a zero-match control master
prep: Seed as AK-001 plus master BTM-R151-D (credit_card) with no invoices
Record the screen rows: search_read with domain [('sales_billing_to_invoice_type','=','super_simple')]
execution: POST /api/dataset/sales.billing.invoice/download_excel with the same domain and standard Invoice List headers
Parse the workbook rows and Invoice Type cells
Repeat both calls with domain credit_card (zero-match control)
assertions: Filtered download row count equals the filtered search_read record count
Every downloaded row's Invoice Type cell matches the screen value for the same Invoice No (super_simple rows only)
INV-DT and INV-DD do not appear in the filtered file
Zero-match control: download returns HTTP 200 with a header row and zero data rows, mirroring the empty screen

answer_keys.why: Requires three DB population states and option-set assertions at each state
prep: State A: fresh transaction with zero billing.to.master rows carrying an Invoice Type (archive or do not create any)
State B: create one master with invoice_print_type=simple
State C: add masters so all seven values are set across records
execution: In each state, read the option values the Invoice List filter exposes (selection surface for sales_billing_to_invoice_type)
Compute the distinct set of invoice_print_type values present on billing.to.master
assertions: State A: option set contains no Invoice Type value (0 typed masters -> nothing selectable)
State B: option set == {simple}
State C: option set == {detailed, simple, direct_debit, credit_card, envelope, envelope_simple, super_simple} with no duplicates
No state ever exposes a value absent from billing.to.master rows

answer_keys.why: Multi-step write/flush/read sequence verifying options and rows move together after a master edit
prep: Create master BTM-X (invoice_print_type=super_simple) and invoice INV-X via sales.billing._action_create_sales_bill_invoice()
execution: Read INV-X.sales_billing_to_invoice_type; re-read the filter option membership
assertions: INV-X reads direct_debit after the edit (relation by id, AMB-003)
Search by super_simple excludes INV-X; search by direct_debit includes INV-X
Option membership and row value agree on the same current master value

answer_keys.why: Two-locale, two-surface parity matrix per Invoice Number
prep: Seed masters super_simple and detailed with one invoice each
Activate ja_JP (lang install + terms load) alongside en_US
execution: en_US: search_read values per invoice, then download_excel with en convert labels; build pairs
ja_JP: repeat with lang=ja_JP context and ja convert labels
Compare screen value vs file cell per Invoice Number per locale
assertions: For every Invoice Number and locale: file cell == screen value (equality of the displayed label)
Locale change changes both surfaces consistently (no row where only one surface switches label)
Values are the localized labels in the active locale, never a raw mismatched-locale label

answer_keys.why: Three-mutation sequence with DB-level recompute assertions (edit, reassign, clear)
prep: Create billing under BTM-P; generate invoice INV-P
execution: Variant 2: billing.billing_to_master_id = BTM-Q; flush; read INV-P; then BTM-P.invoice_print_type = 'credit_card'; flush; read INV-P
Variant 3: BTM-Q.invoice_print_type = False; flush; read INV-P
assertions: Variant 1: INV-P == direct_debit (current master value, AMB-003)
Variant 2: INV-P == detailed; stays detailed after the old master's later edit (no leak)
Variant 3: INV-P is False -> displays blank (AMB-002)
sales_billing_invoice table has no NULL sales_billing_to_invoice_type after each flush

answer_keys.why: Multi-step archive flow with post-action DB and export assertions against a captured baseline
prep: Create master + billing + invoice INV-ARCH with a populated Invoice Type
Record the pre-change archive baseline for the identical flow (action outcome, post-archive visibility)
execution: Execute the Invoice List archive action on INV-ARCH
assertions: Archive action outcome equals the baseline (same success/failure and message set)
Post-archive search_read does not return INV-ARCH (matching baseline behavior)
Post-archive download contains no INV-ARCH row
No error or warning references Invoice Type or the new field
